basic_answer: Use selectors for SS Belt first. If Belt cannot upgrade, check SS Boots, then SS Chest. Tech cores go to Lightning, then Laser. Save S packs unless they finish SS forge. Awakening crystals only if Nutjob/Xeno star finishes now.

spend_plan.title: SS Belt forge
spend_plan.use: Relic chest x2 + Core choice x6 only as needed
spend_plan.do: Open SS Belt forge. If upgrade can finish, do it.
spend_plan.save: If Belt cannot finish, check Boots.

spend_plan.title: SS Boots forge
spend_plan.do: If Belt cannot finish, try Boots next.
spend_plan.save: If Boots cannot finish, check Chest.

spend_plan.title: SS Chest forge
spend_plan.save: If no SS step finishes, keep selectors closed.

spend_plan.title: Tech cores
spend_plan.save: Do not spend these on Soccer.

spend_plan.title: S packs / Void crate
spend_plan.use: S choice x12 + Void crate x1
spend_plan.do: Open only if they finish the SS forge above.

spend_plan.title: Awakening crystals
spend_plan.do: Use only if Nutjob/Xeno next star finishes now.
spend_plan.save: If not enough for star, save.

spend_plan.title: Gems
spend_plan.do: Buy relic cores, tech selectors, Xeno crystals, or guaranteed S/SS selectors.
